post.summary:
The second step, when the first answered `mfa_required`. A wrong code is 401
`invalid_mfa_code`; the fifth wrong code ends the challenge (then `invalid_token`).

post.summary:
202 at once, whether or not the email belongs to anyone: the work (finding the
account, storing the reset, sending the email) runs on its own task, so neither the
answer nor its timing tells which emails exist. The one other answer is 429
`rate_limited` (design note 0009), which depends on the caller's address and the
email asked about, never on whether the account exists.

AddressRequest.description:
An address for the address book. Sending it again (PUT) replaces it whole,
including whether it is a default.

AssetPage.description: A page of a list, newest first (design note 0012).

has_more.description: Whether there are more after these.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; `null` on the last page. Opaque: don't parse it.

checksum.description: SHA-256 as hex, when the uploader declared it.

status.description: Only `ready` assets are listed and can be attached.

thumbnail_url.description:
Images only: a version at most 400 pixels wide when the media URLs can resize,
else the original.

url.description:
The file, once ready. A public file's URL never changes content; a private
file's is signed and works for 15 minutes.

oneOf.description: `null` puts the products back on each country's default rate.

currency.description: The currency of every amount in the cart.

oneOf.description: Who to contact about the order; required at checkout.

fully_available.description: False when any line is unavailable; checkout should refuse such a cart.

market.description: Picked from the country when the cart was created; it sets the currency.

oneOf.description: The order this cart was checked out as; `null` while it can still change.

subtotal.description: Sum of the available lines, as priced. All totals count available lines only.

tax_total.description: Tax on the available lines: part of `subtotal` if `taxes_included`, else on top.

taxes_included.description: Whether line prices include tax (set on the market).

token.description: Send back to `POST /admin/auth/login/mfa` with a code.

code.description: From the authenticator app, or (to disable or regenerate) a recovery code.

scopes.description: Required for a secret key; a publishable key always has the storefront scopes.

byte_size.description:
Exactly the file's size: storage refuses another. Images up to 20 MB, videos up
to 1 GB, PDFs up to 100 MB.

checksum.description: SHA-256 as 64 hex characters: storage then refuses other contents.

filename.description: The file's name, kept for people; up to 255 characters.

continue_selling.description: Keep selling when stock runs out. Defaults to false.

tracked.description: Defaults to true: creating an item is how stock tracking starts.

markets.description: The markets whose buyers this location's stock is sold to.

priority.description: Lower goes first when several locations could fill a line. Defaults to 0.

token.description: The key itself, shown only in this response.

Email.description: An email address; stored trimmed and lowercased, so responses show it that way.

Error.description:
Every error body, for the OpenAPI documents (design note 0010, S9). `ApiError`
serializes as this shape.

code.description: Stable snake_case code: what clients match on.

details.description: Data a client acts on, for the codes that have any (see each operation).

FinancialStatusDto.description:
`FinancialStatus` on the wire. A DTO of its own, so the domain enum carries no
serde and renaming a variant can't silently change the API.

challenge.description: The challenge token from the first step.

code.description: A 6-digit code from the authenticator app, or a recovery code.

InventoryResponse.description:
A variant's stock. `id` is `null` when stock was never set up for the variant,
which means untracked (always sellable).

available.description: `on_hand - reserved`; negative when more is reserved than is there.

reserved.description: Set aside for orders, not yet shipped.

product_title.description:
The product's title now; `null` only when the product or variant is gone, so an
unavailable line still says what it was.

variant_title.description: The variant's option values ("M / Blue"); `null` for a product without options.

oneOf.description: `null` when the cart's country has no tax rates.

LoginResponse.description:
Either `{"status": "authenticated", "session": …}` or `{"status": "mfa_required",
"challenge": …}`: a tagged enum, so a client switches on `status`.

scopes.description: What the session may do: the role's scopes, spelled out for the owner.

Money.description: An amount of money in one currency.

amount.description: In minor units (1050 is 10.50). At most 2^53 - 1 either way, so every amount is exact in JSON.

oneOf.description: `null` when the country had no tax rates.

variant_title.description: The variant's option values ("M / Blue"); `null` for a product without options.

tax_total.description: Part of `subtotal` if `taxes_included`, else on top.

taxes_included.description: Whether line prices include tax (the market decided, at checkout).

OrderSummaryPage.description: A page of a list, newest first (design note 0012).

has_more.description: Whether there are more after these.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; `null` on the last page. Opaque: don't parse it.

OrderSummaryResponse.description: An order in a list: what a table of orders shows, without lines.

item_count.description: How many items, adding up line quantities.

oneOf.description: The class whose rate applied; `null` for the country's default rate.

max.description: Equal to `min` when every variant in this currency costs the same.

options.description:
What variants differ by (Size, Color), in display order; empty for a product
with a single variant.

ProductStatus.description:
`ProductStatus` on the wire: snake_case strings. A DTO of its own, so the domain
enum carries no serde and renaming a variant can't silently change the API.

ProductSummaryPage.description: A page of a list, newest first (design note 0012).

has_more.description: Whether there are more after these.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; `null` on the last page. Opaque: don't parse it.

ProductSummaryResponse.description:
A product in a list: what a table of products shows, without options or variants
(design note 0012, L7). `GET /admin/products/{id}` has the rest.

price_ranges.description:
The lowest and highest variant price in each currency the variants are priced
in, ordered by currency code: usually one.

recovery_codes.description: Shown only now: each works once if the authenticator is lost.

owner.description: The owner role has every scope, including future ones.

token.description: Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Shown only now.

oneOf.description: `null` unlinks the customer (the cart keeps their email).

expected_on_hand.description:
The count last seen. If it moved since (a sale, another count), the request
fails with `on_hand_changed` instead of overwriting it.

password.description:
The current password: a stolen session alone can't put an authenticator on the
account.

oneOf.description: The class whose rate applied; `null` for the country's default rate.

TaxRate.description: A tax rate in parts per million: 250000 is 25 %.

secret.description: Base32, for typing into the app.

UpdateAssetRequest.description: A JSON Merge Patch of an asset's metadata: absent fields stay, `null` clears.

alt.description: Describes the image for screen readers and search engines; up to 255 characters.

title.description: The library's label; up to 255 characters.

UpdateCustomerRequest.description:
JSON Merge Patch (see `patch`): only the fields sent change, `null` clears a name or
phone. The email can be changed but not cleared.

UpdateInventoryItemRequest.description: Every field optional: only the ones sent change.

UpdateLocationRequest.description: Every field optional: only the ones sent change.

UpdateRoleRequest.description: JSON Merge Patch: only the fields sent change.

UpdateStoreRequest.description: A JSON Merge Patch of the store: absent fields stay as they are.

UpdateUserRequest.description: JSON Merge Patch: only the fields sent change.

UploadRequestResponse.description: A request for the client to send itself, with the file as its body.

expires_at.description: RFC 3339, UTC: the URL stops working then.

price.description: The base price, before markets and price lists.

selections.description: One value per option, in the order of `options`.

title.description: Its option values ("M / Blue"); `null` for a product without options.

bearer.description: A staff session (`hypha_sess_…`, from `POST /admin/auth/login`) or a secret API key (`hypha_sk_…`).
